text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I got a wonderful rest~.
Man~, it feels like it's been forever since I was in the Trainer's office~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I had a really fun break—eating with friends
and going to the public bath with the grannies from the shopping arcade.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, it's back to the daily grind from here on out.
Time to fire ourselves up all over again~
